list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: select distinct project_name from project_mapping order by 1

list.name: repo
list.label: Repository
list.query: select substring_index(r.name, '/', -1) as __text, r.id as __value from repos r join project_mapping pm on pm.row_id = r.id and pm.`table` = 'repos' where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) order by 1

list.name: author
list.label: PR author
list.description: Filters the pull request panels and the lead time. Deployments and pipelines are not per author.
list.query: select max(pr.author_name) as __text, pr.author_id as __value from pull_requests pr join project_mapping pm on pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id and pm.`table` = 'repos' where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) and pr.created_date >= date_sub(utc_timestamp(), interval 1 year) and pr.author_id <> '' group by pr.author_id order by 1

panels.title: Deploy days a week
panels.description: Average number of days a week with at least one successful production deployment (Malaysia time). DORA deployment frequency. Elite: on demand, several a day.

targets.rawSql:
with _d as (
  select cdc.cicd_deployment_id as id, max(cdc.finished_date) as fin,
         max(cdc.original_environment) as env, max(cdc.cicd_scope_id) as scope
  from cicd_deployment_commits cdc
  join project_mapping pm on cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id and pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
  where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) and cdc.cicd_scope_id in (${repo:sqlstring})
    and cdc.result = 'SUCCESS' and cdc.environment = 'PRODUCTION'
  group by 1
  having $__timeFilter(max(cdc.finished_date))
)
select round(count(distinct date(date_add(fin, interval 8 hour))) / greatest(timestampdiff(day, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) / 7, 1), 1) as value from _d

panels.title: Production deploys
panels.description: Successful production deployments in the range. Each region and worker deployment counts once (a release to MY, AU, SG, NZ and BN is five).

targets.rawSql:
with _d as (
  select cdc.cicd_deployment_id as id, max(cdc.finished_date) as fin,
         max(cdc.original_environment) as env, max(cdc.cicd_scope_id) as scope
  from cicd_deployment_commits cdc
  join project_mapping pm on cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id and pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
  where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) and cdc.cicd_scope_id in (${repo:sqlstring})
    and cdc.result = 'SUCCESS' and cdc.environment = 'PRODUCTION'
  group by 1
  having $__timeFilter(max(cdc.finished_date))
) select count(*) as value from _d

panels.title: Lead time for changes
panels.description: Median time from a pull request's first commit to its production deployment, for pull requests deployed in the range. DORA lead time for changes.

targets.rawSql:
with _p as (
  select distinct pr.id, pr.base_repo_id as repo, ppm.pr_cycle_time, ppm.pr_coding_time, ppm.pr_pickup_time,
         ppm.pr_review_time, ppm.pr_deploy_time, timestampdiff(minute, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date) as pr_open_time,
         cdc.finished_date as fin
  from pull_requests pr
  join project_pr_metrics ppm on ppm.id = pr.id
  join project_mapping pm on pr.base_repo_id = pm.row_id and pm.`table` = 'repos'
  join cicd_deployment_commits cdc on ppm.deployment_commit_id = cdc.id
  where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) and pr.base_repo_id in (${repo:sqlstring}) and pr.author_id in (${author:sqlstring})
    and pr.merged_date is not null and ppm.pr_cycle_time is not null
    and $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)
),
_r as (select pr_cycle_time, percent_rank() over (order by pr_cycle_time) as rk from _p)
select max(pr_cycle_time) as value from _r where rk <= 0.5

panels.title: Change failure rate
panels.description: Needs incidents. DevLake has none for this project yet, so change failure rate and recovery time are not measured. They are not zero.

targets.rawSql:
select case when count(*) = 0 then 'Not measured' else concat(count(*), ' incidents') end as value
from incidents i join project_mapping pm on pm.row_id = i.scope_id where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring})

panels.title: Production deploys per week
panels.description: Successful production deployments per complete week (Monday to Sunday, Malaysia time). The running week is left out until it ends.

targets.rawSql:
with recursive weeks(w) as (
  select date_add(date_sub(date(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)) day), interval if(weekday(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)) = 0 and time(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)) = '00:00:00', 0, 7) day)
  union all
  select date_add(w, interval 7 day) from weeks
  where date_add(w, interval 7 day) <= date_sub(date_sub(date(date_add($__timeTo(), interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add($__timeTo(), interval 8 hour)) day), interval 7 day)
), _d as (
  select cdc.cicd_deployment_id as id, max(cdc.finished_date) as fin,
         max(cdc.original_environment) as env, max(cdc.cicd_scope_id) as scope
  from cicd_deployment_commits cdc
  join project_mapping pm on cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id and pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
  where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) and cdc.cicd_scope_id in (${repo:sqlstring})
    and cdc.result = 'SUCCESS' and cdc.environment = 'PRODUCTION'
  group by 1
  having $__timeFilter(max(cdc.finished_date))
)
select date_format(w, '%d %b') as week, count(_d.id) as Deploys
from weeks left join _d on date_sub(date(date_add(_d.fin, interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add(_d.fin, interval 8 hour)) day) = w
group by w order by w

panels.title: Deploys by environment
panels.description: Successful production deployments in the range, by Bitbucket environment name without its PRODUCTION- prefix (MY is PRODUCTION-MY). (pipeline) is a deployment found from a pipeline name.

targets.rawSql:
with _d as (
  select cdc.cicd_deployment_id as id, max(cdc.finished_date) as fin,
         max(cdc.original_environment) as env, max(cdc.cicd_scope_id) as scope
  from cicd_deployment_commits cdc
  join project_mapping pm on cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id and pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
  where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) and cdc.cicd_scope_id in (${repo:sqlstring})
    and cdc.result = 'SUCCESS' and cdc.environment = 'PRODUCTION'
  group by 1
  having $__timeFilter(max(cdc.finished_date))
)
select coalesce(nullif(replace(env, 'PRODUCTION-', ''), ''), '(pipeline)') as environment, count(*) as Deploys
from _d group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 12

panels.title: Where the lead time goes
panels.description: Share of each week's lead time spent in each stage (from the median hours of each stage), for pull requests deployed in each complete week: first commit to PR opened (coding), PR opened to merged (review and rework), merged to production deploy. Medians are per stage, so they do not add up to the lead time exactly. Review is not split further because the Bito bot comments on most PRs within seconds.

targets.rawSql:
with recursive weeks(w) as (
  select date_add(date_sub(date(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)) day), interval if(weekday(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)) = 0 and time(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)) = '00:00:00', 0, 7) day)
  union all
  select date_add(w, interval 7 day) from weeks
  where date_add(w, interval 7 day) <= date_sub(date_sub(date(date_add($__timeTo(), interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add($__timeTo(), interval 8 hour)) day), interval 7 day)
), _p as (
  select distinct pr.id, pr.base_repo_id as repo, ppm.pr_cycle_time, ppm.pr_coding_time, ppm.pr_pickup_time,
         ppm.pr_review_time, ppm.pr_deploy_time, timestampdiff(minute, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date) as pr_open_time,
         cdc.finished_date as fin
  from pull_requests pr
  join project_pr_metrics ppm on ppm.id = pr.id
  join project_mapping pm on pr.base_repo_id = pm.row_id and pm.`table` = 'repos'
  join cicd_deployment_commits cdc on ppm.deployment_commit_id = cdc.id
  where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) and pr.base_repo_id in (${repo:sqlstring}) and pr.author_id in (${author:sqlstring})
    and pr.merged_date is not null and ppm.pr_cycle_time is not null
    and $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)
),
_s as (
  select date_sub(date(date_add(fin, interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add(fin, interval 8 hour)) day) as w, 'Coding' as stage, pr_coding_time as v from _p where pr_coding_time is not null
  union all select date_sub(date(date_add(fin, interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add(fin, interval 8 hour)) day) as w, 'Open, until merged' as stage, pr_open_time as v from _p where pr_open_time is not null
  union all select date_sub(date(date_add(fin, interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add(fin, interval 8 hour)) day) as w, 'Merged, until deployed' as stage, pr_deploy_time as v from _p where pr_deploy_time is not null
),
_r as (select w, stage, v, percent_rank() over (partition by w, stage order by v) as rk from _s),
_n as (select w, stage, count(*) as n from _s group by w, stage),
m as (select _r.w, _r.stage, if(max(_n.n) < 5, null, max(_r.v)) as med from _r
      join _n on _n.w = _r.w and _n.stage = _r.stage where _r.rk <= 0.5 group by _r.w, _r.stage)
select date_format(weeks.w, '%d %b') as week,
  round(100 * max(case when m.stage = 'Coding' then m.med end) / nullif(coalesce(max(case when m.stage = 'Coding' then m.med end), 0) + coalesce(max(case when m.stage = 'Open, until merged' then m.med end), 0) + coalesce(max(case when m.stage = 'Merged, until deployed' then m.med end), 0), 0)) as `Coding`,
  round(100 * max(case when m.stage = 'Open, until merged' then m.med end) / nullif(coalesce(max(case when m.stage = 'Coding' then m.med end), 0) + coalesce(max(case when m.stage = 'Open, until merged' then m.med end), 0) + coalesce(max(case when m.stage = 'Merged, until deployed' then m.med end), 0), 0)) as `Open, until merged`,
  round(100 * max(case when m.stage = 'Merged, until deployed' then m.med end) / nullif(coalesce(max(case when m.stage = 'Coding' then m.med end), 0) + coalesce(max(case when m.stage = 'Open, until merged' then m.med end), 0) + coalesce(max(case when m.stage = 'Merged, until deployed' then m.med end), 0), 0)) as `Merged, until deployed`
from weeks left join m on m.w = weeks.w
group by weeks.w order by weeks.w

panels.title: Open pull requests by age
panels.description: Pull requests open right now, by days since they were opened. Not affected by the time range.

targets.rawSql:
select b.bucket as age, count(pr.id) as `Open PRs`
from (select 1 as k, 'Under 1 day' as bucket union all select 2, '1 to 3 days' union all select 3, '3 to 7 days'
      union all select 4, '1 to 4 weeks' union all select 5, 'Over 4 weeks') b
left join (
  select pr.id, case when timestampdiff(hour, pr.created_date, utc_timestamp()) < 24 then 1
                     when timestampdiff(day, pr.created_date, utc_timestamp()) < 3 then 2
                     when timestampdiff(day, pr.created_date, utc_timestamp()) < 7 then 3
                     when timestampdiff(day, pr.created_date, utc_timestamp()) < 28 then 4 else 5 end as k
  from pull_requests pr where pr.status = 'OPEN' and pr.author_id in (${author:sqlstring}) and pr.base_repo_id in (select r.id from repos r join project_mapping pm on pm.row_id = r.id and pm.`table` = 'repos'
  where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) and r.id in (${repo:sqlstring}))
) pr on pr.k = b.k
group by b.k, b.bucket order by b.k

panels.title: Pull requests opened and merged per week
panels.description: Pull requests opened and merged in each complete week (Malaysia time).

targets.rawSql:
with recursive weeks(w) as (
  select date_add(date_sub(date(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)) day), interval if(weekday(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)) = 0 and time(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)) = '00:00:00', 0, 7) day)
  union all
  select date_add(w, interval 7 day) from weeks
  where date_add(w, interval 7 day) <= date_sub(date_sub(date(date_add($__timeTo(), interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add($__timeTo(), interval 8 hour)) day), interval 7 day)
),
_pr as (select pr.created_date, pr.merged_date from pull_requests pr
        where pr.author_id in (${author:sqlstring}) and pr.base_repo_id in (select r.id from repos r join project_mapping pm on pm.row_id = r.id and pm.`table` = 'repos'
  where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) and r.id in (${repo:sqlstring})))
select date_format(w, '%d %b') as week,
  (select count(*) from _pr where date_sub(date(date_add(_pr.created_date, interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add(_pr.created_date, interval 8 hour)) day) = w) as Opened,
  (select count(*) from _pr where _pr.merged_date is not null and date_sub(date(date_add(_pr.merged_date, interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add(_pr.merged_date, interval 8 hour)) day) = w) as Merged
from weeks order by w

panels.title: Pipeline success rate per week
panels.description: Share of finished Bitbucket pipelines that succeeded, per complete week. Stopped or still-running pipelines are left out.

targets.rawSql:
with recursive weeks(w) as (
  select date_add(date_sub(date(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)) day), interval if(weekday(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)) = 0 and time(date_add($__timeFrom(), interval 8 hour)) = '00:00:00', 0, 7) day)
  union all
  select date_add(w, interval 7 day) from weeks
  where date_add(w, interval 7 day) <= date_sub(date_sub(date(date_add($__timeTo(), interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add($__timeTo(), interval 8 hour)) day), interval 7 day)
),
_c as (
  select p.finished_date, p.result from cicd_pipelines p
  join project_mapping pm on pm.row_id = p.cicd_scope_id and pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
  where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) and p.cicd_scope_id in (${repo:sqlstring}) and p.result in ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE')
    and $__timeFilter(p.finished_date)
)
select date_format(w, '%d %b') as week,
  round(100 * sum(_c.result = 'SUCCESS') / nullif(count(_c.result), 0)) as `Succeeded %`
from weeks left join _c on date_sub(date(date_add(_c.finished_date, interval 8 hour)), interval weekday(date_add(_c.finished_date, interval 8 hour)) day) = w
group by w order by w

panels.title: By repository
panels.description: Per repository in the range: production deployments and deploy days, median lead time for pull requests deployed (not linked: no merged PR was matched to a production deployment), pull requests merged, and the share of finished pipelines that succeeded. Repositories with no activity in the range are left out.

targets.rawSql:
with _d as (
  select cdc.cicd_deployment_id as id, max(cdc.finished_date) as fin,
         max(cdc.original_environment) as env, max(cdc.cicd_scope_id) as scope
  from cicd_deployment_commits cdc
  join project_mapping pm on cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id and pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
  where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) and cdc.cicd_scope_id in (${repo:sqlstring})
    and cdc.result = 'SUCCESS' and cdc.environment = 'PRODUCTION'
  group by 1
  having $__timeFilter(max(cdc.finished_date))
), _p as (
  select distinct pr.id, pr.base_repo_id as repo, ppm.pr_cycle_time, ppm.pr_coding_time, ppm.pr_pickup_time,
         ppm.pr_review_time, ppm.pr_deploy_time, timestampdiff(minute, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date) as pr_open_time,
         cdc.finished_date as fin
  from pull_requests pr
  join project_pr_metrics ppm on ppm.id = pr.id
  join project_mapping pm on pr.base_repo_id = pm.row_id and pm.`table` = 'repos'
  join cicd_deployment_commits cdc on ppm.deployment_commit_id = cdc.id
  where pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring}) and pr.base_repo_id in (${repo:sqlstring}) and pr.author_id in (${author:sqlstring})
    and pr.merged_date is not null and ppm.pr_cycle_time is not null
    and $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)
),
_lr as (select repo, pr_cycle_time, percent_rank() over (partition by repo order by pr_cycle_time) as rk from _p),
_lt as (select repo, max(pr_cycle_time) as med from _lr where rk <= 0.5 group by repo),
_dep as (select scope, count(*) as n, count(distinct date(date_add(fin, interval 8 hour))) as days, max(fin) as last from _d group by scope),
_mer as (select base_repo_id as repo, count(*) as n from pull_requests
         where merged_date is not null and author_id in (${author:sqlstring}) and $__timeFilter(merged_date) group by 1),
_ci as (select cicd_scope_id as scope, if(count(*) < 5, null, round(100 * sum(result = 'SUCCESS') / count(*))) as ok, count(*) as runs from cicd_pipelines
        where result in ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE') and $__timeFilter(finished_date) group by 1)
select substring_index(r.name, '/', -1) as Repository,
  coalesce(_dep.n, 0) as `Production deploys`, coalesce(_dep.days, 0) as `Deploy days`,
  _lt.med as `Median lead time`, coalesce(_mer.n, 0) as `PRs merged`, _ci.ok as `Pipeline success`,
  _dep.last as `Last production deploy`
from repos r
join project_mapping pm on pm.row_id = r.id and pm.`table` = 'repos' and pm.project_name in (${project:sqlstring})
left join _dep on _dep.scope = r.id left join _lt on _lt.repo = r.id
left join _mer on _mer.repo = r.id left join _ci on _ci.scope = r.id
where r.id in (${repo:sqlstring}) and (_dep.n is not null or _mer.n is not null or _ci.runs is not null)
order by 2 desc, 5 desc
